items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: I saw Scott Hill just a few weeks ago for the first time in many, many months.

ctx.x: With Les Moskut and various people that you know.
I saw Scott Hill just a few weeks ago for the first time in many, many months. I didn't know if he had left town. Oh, no.
